title: Grounded verification of chemical and materials reasoning: detection is the bottleneck
abstract: arXiv:2607.17417v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Language models are moving into chemistry and materials discovery workflows, where a wrong molecular formula, space group, or formation energy can silently propagate into downstream decisions. These confabulations hide inside fluent reasoning traces and concentrate on rare, long-tail entities, where model confidence is least trustworthy. Retrieving reference data for every prompt would catch them, but at a heavy coverage and abstention cost. We show that deterministic, database-grounded verification catches and repairs these errors selectively, and that the binding constraint is detection rather than repair. Our tiered verifier extracts each checkable claim, tests it against authoritative databases and physical law, and retrieves a reference value only when a check fails. Across four models and over five hundred prompts with pinned conditions, gated correction cuts the error rate of committed formulas from 22% to 4% with 3.2 times fe

translated_title: 化学与材料推理的基于数据库的验证：检测是瓶颈
translated_abstract: 语言模型正进入化学和材料发现工作流程，在这些流程中，错误的分子式、空间群或形成能可能悄然传播到下游决策中。这些虚构内容隐藏在流畅的推理轨迹中，并集中在罕见的长尾实体上，而模型在这些实体上的置信度最不可靠。为每个提示检索参考数据可以捕捉这些错误，但会带来高昂的覆盖率和弃权成本。我们证明，确定性的、基于数据库的验证能够选择性地捕捉并修复这些错误，且约束瓶颈在于检测而非修复。我们的分层验证器提取每个可检查的声明，对照权威数据库和物理定律进行测试，仅在检查失败时检索参考值。在四个模型和超过五百个具有固定条件的提示中，门控修正将承诺分子式的错误率从22%降至4%，且速度提升3.2倍。
tldr: 本文提出一种基于数据库的分层验证方法，发现检测是纠正化学和材料推理中错误的关键瓶颈，门控修正可将错误率从22%降至4%。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a database-grounded tiered verification method, revealing that detection is the key bottleneck in correcting errors in chemical and materials reasoning, reducing the error rate from 22% to 4%.
